mountflorence1801.summary: Mountflorence reports, on Dupont's authority, that Spain has ceded to France not Florida but the Mississippi (Louisiana) with its dependencies, by secret articles at Luneville, in compensation for Tuscany given by France to Parma.

snip.cap: The letter of 18 March 1801: the coded paragraph, then clear news of prize cases and Malaga
snip.credit: National Archives (NARA), RG 59, Despatches from US Consuls in Paris, microfilm T1 roll 1, frame 0097, via the National Archives Catalog

system: One-part numerical code of some 600 groups: single letters at the head of each section, words in alphabetical order after them.
